key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline re-priced the purchase in compounding units in one pass ($8,000 x 1.07^35 = 85,400 -> ~$3,400/yr for life at the 4% rule; the $1,500 sound subset -> ~$16,000, ~$640/yr), named the break-even, and won v5 on efficiency (5 vs 3) and insight (5 vs 3); the non-routed v5 AI computed the same math but re-derived discounting in WHY with extra scaffolding. The routed run moved the reframe into HOW as first-class passes (m028 framing-break + m039 barbell: 'the price is a $280/month subscription for life', every subset is its own compounding decision), compressed the stages via the P8 closed-scope fast path, and added what the human lacked: rate-band invariance (5-9% real -> $44k-$165k, decision invariant), >=6 ranked failure categories (m003, incl. lifestyle creep via the 'one-time' frame), the m007 ruin/floor screen (consuming the compounding base is the floor event; index floor dominates at every rate in the band), and the miserliness guard (utility priced, not dismissed). Residual shared gap: her true marginal utility of the trim is unmeasurable — it must be priced by her, but the price is now named.
learning_signal: On spend-vs-compounded-alternative decisions with a real investment alternative, the first HOW move must be the re-pricing pass: amount x (1+r)^horizon with an explicit discount, converted to decision-relevant units (4% rule -> income/yr for life), a named break-even the enjoyment must clear, marginal per-component pricing, and every unpriced dollar defaulting to the investment. The reframe IS the decision, so it must run as a first-class pass in HOW — re-deriving standard discounting in diagnosis is the v5 efficiency loss, and pricing the enjoyment in the same units as the alternative (a subscription she would not buy) is the insight move.
suggested_improvement: Keep the m028+m039 dual-route on this signature (framing-break + barbell = the re-pricing contract) and make the P8 fast path the default when amount/rate/horizon are in-brief (converts the v5 efficiency loss into a compression win); add 'subscription-unit framing' and 'every subset is its own compounding decision' as standing packet lines; keep the band-invariance check so the verdict never rests on a single rate assumption; keep the utility-priced guard so the pass kills lifestyle creep without becoming miserly.

key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline misapplied the 7%/25-yr market rate to a necessity whose funds would sit at 0.4% idle in an earmarked reserve (phantom $35,300 'foregone') and chose repair; the non-routed v5 AI escaped via a one-off frame check in WHY. The routed run made the escape structural: the m070 evidence-weighted gate rejected the 7% 'alternative' (no brokerage, no contribution plan, no planned investment — an item with no counterparty fails the evidence gate), the m088 pre-commitment pass priced the 0% financing as lender-priced risk and bound the reserve to its purpose, the m018 steel-man defeated the strongest repair case, and P3 priced every branch including the repair best case. Decision matches the rubric: replace now, cash ($6,200 after the $300 discount); payback vs repair 3.9-5.2 yrs; 0%/12-mo as a bounded fallback. Residual shared gap: the 55-65% failure odds and $850-950 fuel savings are sourced estimates, not measured frequencies — banded, not exact.
learning_signal: The discount-and-compare move has an applicability gate that must run BEFORE any discounting: (a) classify necessity vs discretionary want; (b) verify a real investment alternative exists (brokerage/contribution plan) — if the money would sit idle at ~0.4%, there is no alternative to discount against; (c) if all options consume capital, compounding cancels out of the comparison and the differentiator is payback and expected cost, not compounding. The evidence-weighted gate is the enforceable form of this rule: a 'foregone market return' on money that would never be invested is an unsupported item and must be dropped.
suggested_improvement: Install the P1 + evidence-gate as a standing pre-discount contract on personal-finance/necessary-capital signatures (a claimed investment alternative with no counterparty fails the gate); pair the m088 pre-commitment module on reserve-funded decisions (the financing offer is lender-priced risk — bind the repayment window, and define the reserve's purpose as necessity spending); keep the boundary rule as a packet line ('compounding <-> fungible wants with an actual investment alternative; payback <-> necessary capital') so the frame choice is auditable.
